Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
RegConfigIndex
ModifyTime
Unix modify time, indicating last file modification. NOTE: modifiable by users.
UpdateTime
Shimcache Last Updated time.
ExecFlag
Execution flag for cache entry: Yes, No or Empty, NOTE: Not always accurate.
RegControlsetId
Identification of the registry section which stores the Shim cache data.
ShimEntries
The number of entries in the Shim artifact as reported by the artifact itself.
ShimMagicCode
A unique identifier within the Shim artifact, which determines what format the data is in.
ShimSizeInBytes
Number of bytes in the Shim artifact as reported by the artifact itself.
